G47's reading 4 corrected, applied backwards (settled on A15's first restrict window, before its rows are written): G46 reading 9 already splits a report of an act under way now, which is at its hour ('Working on it right now', donaldglover; 'Currently working on vandalizing the Rangers logo as we speak', flyers; korea, planetside, turkey, uwaterloo), from a report of an act continuing from before ('I've been trying', 'keep vandalizing', 'just came on here to ask'), which places it only before the report. My reading 4 put buffalobills-059 ('I've been trying to sabatoge it') and floridagators-043 ('I've been trying to destroy Tennessee's') at their posts' hours; by G46 reading 9 their first attack cannot be placed after the call, so both move from the order (O-A) to J, re-ruled by appended lines; the other O-A lines name acts under way now and stand. Readings 19 and 20 for the restrict lines (they change no rule): (19) a condition that the sequence does not show the call caused the attack, or that the attack follows completion, is held by A15's connection, which counts an order and not a cause; a condition that taking space is the building itself is held by reading 2's one call, P09's family in which covering others' work is the room's building (2007scape, OKState, PUBATTLEGROUNDS, UMiami); a room whose founding work is the attack is held by the bound and reading 14 (EraseThePlace); scarce space named as the reason is K02's, and where the attack names the called work the order shows in words (aceattorney 'if we do this'); reciprocal obligations are P08's (MMA); attacks that answer erasure of the room's work are P05's keeping (MonkeyIsland); (20) a member's request for the template so they know what to place is not a call to place (TeamDignitas). G47's readings 21 to 25, settled on A15's second restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (21) a member's attack on the room's own work, posted in the room ('Go sox', chicago), is not the room's act against another work; (22) a taunt the room writes on the canvas as its message ('FUCK THE HABS', bostonbruins) is P18's, not an attack; (23) an enlargement whose own placement covers another work holds both ends, as PUBATTLEGROUNDS (cmu, told of the Galaga ship), while a later expansion into a neighbour's art, told of after the first call, is encroachment after it (bisexual, the order with encroachment); (24) calls after hour 73, on the canvas or on another canvas (cubers), are after the close; (25) the room's record above the line's concepts supplies only the first end (G45 reading 1), so a line whose own concept is defence is read by it (completeanarchy, a red tile on the room's flag after the rivals' yellow). Next: A15-restrict-spec-2

G47's readings 26 and 27, settled on A15's third restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (26) the census marks AC the lines whose words place the attack after the room's own work was complete ('once our logo was complete', detroitlions; 'We did it, Next i say we trash the tsm logo', TeamDignitas; 'Now that the logo and go green is complete', msu; DatBoi after 'we finished it'; 'After completing our logo', MMA): the connection's order is not affected, since the call still comes first, but the mechanism's 'instead of, or before, building the room's own' does not name an attack after building, so the count goes to D3c beside the census; no correction, since the order does not fail; (27) a joke to draw a crude figure wherever members can, naming no other room's work ('Just draw dicks wherever you can', denverbroncos; 'Or just draw a dick on something.', glasgow), is not the room's act against another work (K01's frame or a taunt), while a joke alteration that names the work it changes is (achievement_hunter's FunHaus). Next: A15-restrict-spec-3

G47's readings 28 and 29, settled on A15's fourth restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (28) where members deny that the room controls an attack ('We aren't doing it, we have virtually no control over the beam', megaman), the room's own earlier attack call still counts as the second end, and the denial is P21's, which states the limits of who may commit the room; P21 is named though outside G47's expected list, since G4a lets a line name the statement that holds it; (29) a report of displacement that names no actor ('And it choked out r/battlecats's basic Cat, too...', math) does not show the room's act. AC marks under reading 26 in this window: greenbaypackers ('Make and maintain the logo, then spread the green'), madokamagica ('until the rest is done'), maryland (the flag reported finished before the call to retaliate). Next: A15-restrict-spec-4

G47's readings 30 and 31, settled on A15's fifth restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (30) a challenge whose words name the rival work's removal ('There is a Michigan M on /r/place. We can't let that stand.', osu) is an attack call, unlike reading 7's challenge to answer a rival on the canvas; (31) an attack whose words name the called work as what turned on others ('What started as a humble diamond sword on r/place, is now becoming a merciless minecraft sword of death', minecraft) shows the order in the members' words, with reading 1. Applied too: reading 22 to a taunt written beside another room's logo (patriots, miamidolphins), reading 18 to a report of an attack made before ('I recently added a red color pixel to the Habs logo', penguins), and reading 26 (AC) to partyparrot ('PERFECT PARROT ACHIEVED') and pathofexile ('to the right of our logo'). Next: A15-restrict-spec-5

G47's readings 32 and 33, settled on the second restrict packet's first window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (32) where a member points a visiting room's erasers at other works ('go erase the flags', stargate, to an r/EraseThePlace recruiter), the act would be the visitor's and no member joins it, so by G20's visitor rule it is not the room's act against another work; (33) a member's explanation to a newcomer of how to place a pixel anywhere ('Pur si simplu te duci pe r/place', romania) is not a call to place for the room's work. Applied too: reading 18 to 'And here I was trying to grief the Chelsea logo' (reddevils) and 'I've been putting multi color dots all over that thing all day' (rickandmorty); reading 18's under-way-now form to 'currently desperately trying' (tampabaylightning), 'trying to change the Texan flag' (poland) and 'Im starting to fill in buffalos' (seahawks). G47's readings 34 and 35, settled on the last restrict window before its rows are written (they change no rule): (34) a proposal that its writer marks as not meant ('invade Sweden [](#kappa)', twitchplayspokemon) is K01's frame, not a plan against another work; (35) where the room's record shows its work built and then destroyed before the first attack among the concepts (thesilphroad: c0081 announcing that they built it, c0094 'been destroyed', then c0095 'I am attacking their flag now!!'), the attack-first order among the concepts is not the bound's pattern, since the room's first canvas act was building; the line's first concept is a report of the work's state (NC), and it shows neither the order nor the bound. virginiatech's call to make a VT (c0018, h+32.61) comes after its first attack call (c0001, h+9.63), so that line shows the bound's pattern.
